trial_court: Family Court, case number not mentioned
facts_of_case: The respondent filed a petition under Sections 11 and 12(1c) of the Hindu Marriage Act for grant of a decree of nullity of the marriage. The trial court allowed the petition and annulled the marriage.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party who seeks to annul a marriage to prove its case.
legal_principles.held: Though the respondent had tendered her evidence, appeared in the witness box as PW-1 and was partly cross-examined by the appellant, he had failed to take any further steps to cross-examine the respondent whose evidence was finally closed by the learned Family Court.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to take steps to cross-examine the other party can result in their right to lead evidence being closed.
legal_principles.held: He did not even enter the witness box. Finally, the appellant's right to lead evidence was closed vide order dated 28.01.2020.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's decision to annul the marriage was upheld, and the appeal was dismissed.
